entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's a piece of junk. It's constantly disconnecting from my phone.
I understand your frustration. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. Could you please provide me with your order number or email address associated with the purchase?
Here's the order number: VF12345. Look, I don't have time for this. I just want to return it. It's only been a couple of weeks.

Thank you. I have located your order. I understand you want to initiate a return for your VeloBand Pulse. Let me check our return policy for you. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the date of purchase to return the item, provided it's in good condition.
90 days? Okay, that's what I wanted to hear. This whole thing's been a pain. I was worried I was outside the window.
Yes, absolutely. The 90 days applies to most of our products. To clarify, are there any visible damages to the VeloBand Pulse, such as scratches or cracks?
No, it's perfectly fine physically. I just can't get it to stay connected. I tried everything. I even watched the videos you guys provide on how to pair a smart watch. Nothing worked!

I apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced. Since it's within our return policy, I'll go ahead and process the return for you. We'll send you a prepaid shipping label to your email address within 24 hours. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse securely in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at your nearest shipping location.
Okay, and how long will it take to get my refund?

Once we receive the returned item, please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to be processed and credited back to your original payment method. If you don't receive the refund within that timeframe, please don't hesitate to call us back. On the return policy, it is noted that refunds will not appear in your account until the product is received.
Alright, that sounds good. Thank you. I appreciate your help. I was prepared to argue, but this was easy.

You're very welcome! We strive to make the return process as smooth as possible. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Perhaps you'd be interested in our other fitness trackers, although maybe not the VeloBand Pulse, haha.
No, I think I'm good for now. Thanks again.
You're welcome! Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer!
